summary: Every ROA day file read by the validation holds all five trust anchors except 2026-04-04 (AFRINIC), whose set in RIPE's archive is empty (59 events; no label changes with that anchor from the adjacent days); on 46 further days RIPE archived one anchor at 10%-85% of its usual size, and re-validating those 990 events with that anchor from the adjacent days changes 3 unknown to invalid (one more unknown origin is covered on both adjacent days), of 79,870 events in all; the 45 R2-window days and all 47 new-period files are complete.
summary_detail: Development (replay 2022-01-01..2026-08-31): of 1704 event days, 1698 read their own ROA day file, 6 the 7-day fallback file (2023-06-24->2023-06-23, 2023-07-14->2023-07-13, 2023-07-15->2023-07-13, 2023-07-16->2023-07-13, 2023-07-17->2023-07-13, 2026-06-13->2026-06-12) and 0 no file. Stored labels of all 79,870 events are reproduced exactly from these files (79,870 identical). 1 file lacks an anchor (2026-04-04 (AFRINIC)); 46 files hold one anchor below 90% of its local median (6 below 50%). 1049 events fall on these 47 days. Repairing the affected anchor from the nearest unflagged earlier and later day: new-origin changes where both repairs agree {'unknown->invalid': 3}, displaced-origin {'unknown->valid': 3}, 1 stored unknown covered under both repairs with differing class, 8 changes under one repair only (ROA churn on the adjacent day). Stored valid or invalid labels that change under both repairs: none. RIPE archive today: 47 of 47 flagged anchor-days match the archived roas.csv row count; header-only at RIPE: 2026-04-04 afrinic. Of the 6 days that read the fallback file, 6 are absent from RIPE's archive for all five anchors (HTTP 404). later_validity.py (t0+7/t0+30 of invalid events) reads 1726 days: 46 on flagged files, 9 without file (2026-09-22, .., 2026-09-30). New period: 47 files 2026-08-31..2026-10-16, 0 flagged; the 45 R2-window days and 47 event days all read their own file; stored labels of 224,466 new-period events reproduced exactly (224,466).

rules.fetch: scripts/fetch_roas.py: one roas.csv.xz per TAL and day from https://ftp.ripe.net/rpki/<tal>.tal/YYYY/MM/DD/; a TAL with HTTP 404 or without asn/prefix/max-length columns is skipped silently, a header-only CSV adds no rows; a day file is never re-fetched once written
rules.day_selection: src/bgbench/rpki_validate.py roas_for(day): <root>/rpki/roas/<day>.parquet, else the nearest earlier day file within 7 days, else no_roa_data
rules.development_event_day: scripts/rpki_validity_events.py: event_id[:8] (first_ts UTC day of the selected origin change)
rules.newperiod_event_day: finalize kernel validate_origins (.agents/operations/newperiod-family-history-stage-r3-20261024/execution/package-v1/kernel/replay.py): first_ts UTC day of inventory/2026/replay_selection.parquet
rules.classes: validity of the new origin: valid | invalid (invalid_asn | invalid_length) | unknown, no_roa_data without a file; prev_validity of the displaced origin (unknown_prev when none)
rules.flags: tal absent; tal 'short' = rows < 0.9 x median rows of that tal in the +-15 neighbouring files (band below 0.5 reported separately); nonzero nulls; unexpected tal values
rules.repair: events on a flagged file are re-validated with the event day's ROAs of the unaffected TALs plus the affected TAL's ROAs of the nearest unflagged earlier (later) file within 7 days
rules.validity_function: verbatim copy of src/bgbench/rpki_validate.py validity (file sha256 817f435fdaaf25031bf3e1b37e6e2a4f702bfb0e8c75eaba3a9f3a250261b342)
